Here is an absolute basic ref for only getting a custom banner for your subverse. These are to be placed in the "Subverse settings" where it says "custom stylesheet." I am not an expert. But, these are the settings I've found to work the best. First, you need a custom image. I've found that these dimensions work the best: 1375x137 (Height is dependent, also, on the height settings in the CSS script. However, with the height being 137, you have the clearance for the name of the sub to not be overlapped by the image.

header {

background-image:url('your image's link here'); border-color:#ffffff; border-bottom-width:2px; height:137px !important; position:relative; z-index:99; }

Make sure to delete the quotes and the text within the quotes and replace it with the image's url. If using imgur, make sure it's the link with the i in it. Example: http://i.imgur.com/dnjNnDL.png##

And that's it!

... to adjusting the height of the banner:

#header {

 height: 190px !important;
}
#header-bottom-left {
 margin-top: 129px;
}
